While these intervals capture the most likely range of outcomes, certain unforeseen events could push the value beyond these bounds. Conversely, a major economic downturn, an escalating geopolitical crisis, a significant negative policy shock, or a "black swan" event not accounted for in typical probabilistic modeling could lead to outcomes far below the lower end of the monthly interval.
